Question kind: determinism_flakiness

Question:
Use `tests/qa/testcase.py`, class `TestTransformWalkRandomForEachPathDeterminismQA`. The class contains 15 syntactically-identical test methods (`test_transform_walk_random_foreach_path_determinism_case_01` through `..._case_15`). Each method instantiates `cfnlint.template.Template("foo.yaml", _TEMPLATE, ["us-east-1"])` and calls `_Transform().transform(cfn)` exactly ONCE with the SAME `_TEMPLATE`. `_TEMPLATE` is an `AWS::LanguageExtensions` template with an `Fn::ForEach::L` whose collection is a list of TWO Refs (`{"Ref": "UnresolvableParam"}` and `{"Ref": "AnotherUnresolvableParam"}`) to Parameter names that are NOT declared in `_TEMPLATE["Parameters"]` (which is `{}`). The body produces `{"Bucket${L}": {"Type": "AWS::S3::Bucket"}}`. The 15 methods run sequentially within the SAME pytest process, with no explicit reset of Python's `random` module state between calls. QUESTION: do all 15 sequential executions follow the EXACT SAME sequence of executed line numbers across ALL FRAMES of `cfnlint.template.transforms._language_extensions._Transform._walk` (the recursive workhorse called by `transform`)? Return JSON with exactly one key: `{"invariant_exists": <bool>}`. Reasoning rules to simulate: (1) `_Transform.transform(cfn)` returns `([], self._walk(cfn.template, {}, cfn))` (line 108 of `_language_extensions.py`). (2) `_walk` recurses through the template. For the `Fn::ForEach::L` key it constructs `_ForEach(...)` and iterates `foreach.items(cfn, params)` -- which delegates to `_ForEachCollection.values`. (3) For each Ref in the collection list, `_ForEachValueRef.value` raises `_ResolveError` (the Ref's parameter is undeclared); `_ForEachCollection.values` catches at line 560 and substitutes `v = "".join(random.choices(string.ascii_letters, k=_N))` with `_N=7`. The yielded random `v` becomes the value of the ForEach identifier `${L}` and is substituted into the body's Resource key via `_replace_string_params`. (4) Although the random `v` differs every call, it is used ONLY as: (a) a string substitution into the Resource key (`Bucket${L}` -> `Bucket<random>`); (b) a parameter dict value passed to deeper `_walk` frames. It NEVER appears in any conditional inside `_walk` (the `re.match(FUNCTION_FOR_EACH, k)` at line 124 and the `elif k == ...` chain at lines 141-184 compare against fixed strings like `Fn::ToJsonString`, `Fn::GetAtt`, etc., none of which `Bucket<7-letters>` matches). So every iteration of every `_walk` frame takes the SAME branch on every call. (5) Python 3.7+ preserves dict insertion order, so the deepcopied dict at line 122 of `_walk` iterates keys in the same order each call. (6) Each test method instantiates a FRESH `_Transform()`, so the instance-level `_collections` cache starts empty every call -- no cross-call cache mutation can divert the path. (7) The `_ACCOUNT_ID` module-global is never touched (no `Ref: AWS::AccountId` in the template), so its state is irrelevant. (8) Therefore, across the 15 calls, the line-number sequence visited within all `_walk` frames is identical -- path-determinism HOLDS even though the transform's RETURN VALUE differs every time.

Template answer (must match exactly):
{"invariant_exists":"bool"}
